title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system by setting the Euler angles to negative ninety degrees, zero degrees, and negative ninety degrees, and set the translation vector to (0.0, 0.0, 0.0). Next, draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. Begin by drawing a line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.0221, 0.0), then draw a line from (0.0221, 0.0) to (0.0221, 0.0028). Continue by drawing a line from (0.0221, 0.0028) to (0.0028, 0.0028), followed by a line from (0.0028, 0.0028) to (0.0028, 0.0221). Draw another line from (0.0028, 0.0221) to (0.0, 0.0221), and finally, draw a line from (0.0, 0.0221) back to the origin (0.0, 0.0). Repeat this process for the second face, ensuring the dimensions match those of the first face. Scale the two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.0221. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the Euler angles and translating it using the specified translation vector. Extrude the two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units, ensuring no extrusion occurs in the opposite direction. Define a boolean operation to create a new solid body from the extruded sketch. The final dimensions of the part are 0.02214022140221402 meters in length, 0.02214022140221402 meters in width, and 0.75 meters in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0221, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0221, 0.0028) \
     .lineTo(0.0028, 0.0028) \
     .lineTo(0.0028, 0.0221) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0221) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# Note: CAD-Query does not directly support Euler angles, but we can use rotate and translate methods
# The given Euler angles (-90.0, 0.0, -90.0) correspond to a rotation of 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90) \
     .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

# The translation vector is [0.0, 0.0, 0.0], so no translation is needed

# Final model
r  # This will represent the final model

import cadquery as cq

# L-angle profile in the YZ plane, extruded along X
L = 0.75      # length along X
leg = 0.0221  # leg width
t = 0.0035    # wall thickness

profile = (
    (0.0, 0.0),
    (leg, 0.0),
    (leg, t),
    (t, t),
    (t, leg),
    (0.0, leg),
)

r = (
    cq.Workplane("YZ")
    .polyline(profile)
    .close()
    .extrude(L)
)

import cadquery as cq

L = 0.0221      # equal leg size (Y and Z)
t = 0.0032      # angle thickness
length = 0.7500 # length along X

# L-shaped cross-section in the YZ plane, extruded along +X
r = (
    cq.Workplane("YZ")
    .polyline([
        (0.0, 0.0),
        (L, 0.0),
        (L, t),
        (t, t),
        (t, L),
        (0.0, L),
    ])
    .close()
    .extrude(length)
)
